about: The Windows app-folder rule (R-31), as one table both implementations run: crates/biorouter-mcp/src/app_folder/tests.rs and ui/desktop/src/utils/appFolder.test.ts. Each case builds `before` under an empty temporary base directory, runs the move once per entry of `runs` (writing the move marker, as for the roaming folder), and expects that outcome from each run, then the folder named by `resolves`, then every `exists` path present and every `absent` path missing. Path tokens: `current` is <base>/<APP_AUTHOR>/<APP_NAME>, `legacy` is <base>/<LEGACY_APP_AUTHOR>/<APP_NAME>, `currentParent` and `legacyParent` are their author folders, `lookalike` is <base>/<LEGACY_APP_AUTHOR>2/<APP_NAME>, and `marker` is the move marker's file name. A trailing slash in `before` makes an empty directory instead of a file. `renameFails` makes every rename attempt fail, as a file held open by another process does on Windows.

cases.name: a fresh install starts in the current folder and creates nothing yet
the legacy folder alone is moved whole, marker inside, and its emptied author folder removed
an author folder that also holds another app keeps it, and is not removed
the current folder alone is used as it is
when both exist the current folder wins and the legacy one is left untouched
an empty legacy author folder an interrupted run left behind is tidied
a folder whose author only starts like the legacy one is never touched
a refused rename keeps the legacy folder in use, with its marker for the next attempt
a refused rename never removes a current author folder it did not create
